title: Xreal Aura Wired Headset Announced
excerpt: Xreal introduces the Aura, a new wired headset running on Android XR starting at $1,279 with specific launch apps.
body_html:
Xreal has announced the Xreal Aura, a new wired headset operating on the Android XR platform. The device will be priced starting at $1,279.

According to the details provided, the headset will feature multiple extended reality specific applications available right at its launch.
